column1: # Committed shape rules for scan-git.mjs: credential and private-data SHAPES, never words.
# They judge every commit everywhere (a contributor's clone, CI on a fork's pull request),
# with or without the maintainer's private rules (scripts/leak-scan/README.md).
# label<TAB>kind<TAB>value[<TAB>allow pattern...]; an allow pattern drops a hit whose
# surrounding text matches it (case-insensitive). Every rule here is source-only by nature:
# Credentials gitleaks has no rule for, or that Walnut itself mints.
# A gitleaks inline allow comment silences gitleaks on its line: never in a new line.
